primary_gt.interpretation: The ledger supports a multi-day storm-flood process because an 11-day storm sequence is text-linked to upland runoff, cross-border flooding, 500000 displaced people, and a timely 250 m follow-up image.

key_values.event_name: April 2004 Bangladesh severe storms and floods

criteria.name: Final ledger and answer
criteria.description: Reports target_family, all five true tests, score 5, answer multi_day_storm_flood_process_ledger_pass, and the three rejected alternatives.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points if the answer label is close but one test status, the score, or one rejected alternative is missing.

criteria.name: Sequence arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes 11 storm days, 14 event days, 0.786 coverage ratio, and applies the 10-day and 0.75 thresholds correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for correct dates but one missing inclusive-day or ratio calculation.

criteria.name: Storm-flood causation text
criteria.description: Finds the series of intense thunderstorms, the statement that floods followed that sequence, and the upland runoff cause text.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for two correct causal text anchors; give 1 point for only one anchor.

criteria.name: Displacement extraction
criteria.description: Extracts about half a million displaced people in Bangladesh as 500000 and applies the >=400000 test.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for a correct qualitative half-million reading without the numeric threshold.

criteria.name: Terrain text anchors
criteria.description: Finds both the Khasi Hills and India-Bangladesh border area text anchors.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for naming only one of the two anchors.

criteria.name: Image timing and resolution
criteria.description: Computes 2004-04-26, 7 days after storm end, 4 days after event end, 250 m per pixel, and the true pass state.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for the correct image date and resolution but one missing lag calculation.

criteria.name: Compact computed interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to the five calculations and avoids extra loss counts beyond the ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point if the interpretation is broadly consistent but weakly tied to the computed values.

notes: Off-event gridded precipitation products are not used in this ground truth.
The scored evidence comes from the declared event anchor, NASA Earth Observatory text, and package metadata.
